name: Deli Turkey Salad with Cranberries, Almonds, Goat Cheese & Balsamic
ingredients: 16 oz oven roasted turkey breast, sliced
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Place mixed greens and carrots in a large bowl.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the mixed greens.
Halve tomatoes lengthwise and add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Stack turkey slices one on top of another, then medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese. Add to the bowl along with the almonds, cranberries, and dressing; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
